events.verdict: Randle (MIN) goes to, not through, Grimes' (PHI) space and marginal contact occurs as Randle releases away with his left forearm during the drive.
McDaniels (MIN) initiates illegal contact with Yabusele's (PHI) left arm as he wraps him up during the shot attempt.

During Yabusele' (PHI) free throw attempt, Bona's (PHI) left elbow makes contact with Alexander-Walker's (MIN) face. A referee-initiated review occurs to determine if a hostile act occurred. Upon review, the contact by Bona is deemed inadvertent and there is no penalty assessed on the play.
Gobert (MIN) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Grimes' (PHI) driving shot attempt.
Grimes (PHI) does not give Edwards (MIN) space to land as he attempts to secure the rebound, causing him to fall and lose control of the ball as he returns to the ground.
Edwards (MIN) initiates illegal contact with Walker IV's (PHI) right arm as he attempts to gather the ball.
Bona (PHI) makes clean contact with the ball prior to incidental follow-through contact with Conley's (MIN) left arm as the ball is coming loose.
A ref-initiated review occurs to determine if Grimes' (PHI) basket was 2-point or 3-point shot. After communicating with the Replay Center, the call on the floor of 3-point shot is confirmed.
Grimes (PHI) appears to attempt to commit a take foul on Randle (MIN), though the contact is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Grimes (PHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Grimes' arm briefly becomes tangled with Randle's (MIN) right arm as they pursue the loose ball and the contact that occurs is marginal. As Randle had possession at the time of the whistle, play correctly resumes with Minnesota retaining possession.
Conley (MIN) signals for and is awarded a timeout prior to 5 seconds elapsing.
Randle (MIN) establishes screening position in Walker IV's (PHI) path and incidental body contact occurs between the two as Walker IV attempts to move over the screen.
